_comment: The installation commands, in one place, each on a single line.
The site renders them (web/lib/install-commands.ts) and the CI workflow
scripts/install-one-liner.mjs, so a documented command that does not work
fails a run instead of a reader. A test asserts both sides agree.

commands.go: CGO_ENABLED=0 go install {module}/cmd/ccresu@latest && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/ccresu" version
commands.source: git clone {clone} && cd ccresu && make build && ./ccresu version
